edges.reason: msg.sender is resolved as the 'from' address in the transfer flow.
msg.sender is used as the spender in allowance bookkeeping of transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _FeeAddress1/_FeeAddress2 for privileged calls.
block.timestamp gates buy/sell cooldown and early launch restrictions.
openTrading sets _launchedAt from the current block.timestamp.
_getFee raises the sell fee if block.timestamp is within 15 minutes of launch.
Router swap deadline is supplied as block.timestamp.
tx.origin is read inside transferFrom to compare against the recipient.
tx.origin equality check forms the anti-bot require statement.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, which performs an external router call.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to sendETHToFee, performing native transfers.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
lockTheSwap writes _inSwap before and after the external router call.
manualswap triggers the external swap path on the whole contract balance.
manualsend routes the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
sendETHToFee transfers half the amount to _FeeAddress1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the amount to _FeeAddress2.
_FeeAddress1 is the payable destination of the ETH transfer.
_FeeAddress2 is the payable destination of the ETH transfer.
_getValues performs amount * teamFee / 100 fee arithmetic.
Computed fee values flow into _transferStandard balance updates.
_transferStandard performs balance arithmetic on the _owned mapping.
Resulting balance math writes the _owned mapping.
_transferStandard updates sender and recipient balances in _owned.
_transferStandard routes the collected team fee to _takeTeam.
_takeTeam adds the fee to the contract balance in _owned.
Multicall writes _isBot flags for arbitrary addresses.
setFees enforces msg.sender == _FeeAddress1 before changing fees.
manualswap enforces msg.sender == _FeeAddress1.
updateFeeAddress1 writes the _FeeAddress1 privilege address.
updateFeeAddress2 writes the _FeeAddress2 privilege address.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee application.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping for buys.
_transfer requires the sender is not flagged in _isBot.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Pair for buy/sell detection.
_transfer requires _tradingOpen before buy/sell logic executes.
_transfer enforces the _maxBuyAmount limit during the early window.
_transfer enforces the _maxHeldTokens limit after launch.
_transfer conditionally caps the swap using _useImpactFeeSetter.
openTrading stores the launch timestamp into _launchedAt.
_getFee reads _buyFee when the transfer is a buy.
_getFee reads _sellFee when the transfer is a sell.
setFees writes the _buyFee state variable.
setFees writes the _sellFee state variable.
setFeeRate writes the _feeRate state variable.
toggleImpactFee writes the _useImpactFeeSetter state variable.
_owner is compared in _transfer to bypass fee logic for the owner.
addLiquidity assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
addLiquidity creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
transferFrom reads _allowances to validate and decrement allowance.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
transferFrom computes the remaining allowance into allowedAmount.
amount parameter flows into the _transfer routine.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer routine.
sender parameter flows into the _transfer routine.
_transfer sets the isBuy flag while evaluating buy conditions.
isBuy is propagated into _transferStandard via _tokenTransfer.
_transfer computes the takeFee flag from exclusion mappings.
takeFee is propagated into _transferStandard.
_transfer reads the contract token balance into contractTokenBalance.
contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokensForEth.
_transfer reads the contract ETH balance into contractETHBalance.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
_getFee returns the computed fee percentage.
fee value flows into _transferStandard through _tokenTransfer.
_getValues returns the net transferAmount.
transferAmount is credited in _transferStandard.
_getValues returns the team fee amount.
team fee is passed into _takeTeam.
tokenAmount parameter is used to build the swap path and call.
rate parameter is written into _feeRate.
bots_ array is iterated to set _isBot flags.
bots_ array is iterated to clear _isBot flags.

normalization_plan.reason: Amount is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by _transfer.
Recipient is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by _transfer.
Sender is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by _transfer.
isBuy is a local control flag computed inside _transfer.
takeFee is a local decision flag computed inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance only exists to size the swap in swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance only exists to fund sendETHToFee.
fee is the transient value applied by _transferStandard.
transferAmount is a transient arithmetic result credited by _transferStandard.
team is the transient fee amount handled by _takeTeam.
tokenAmount is the swap size argument of swapTokensForEth.
rate is the configuration argument of setFeeRate.
bots_ is the address list argument iterated by Multicall.
allowedAmount is the transient allowance remainder computed in transferFrom.
